g.title: Unpredictable income. A clearer plan for your money.
Flow brings your income, invoices, and expenses into one view. See what’s coming in, what’s due, and what you can set aside.
Your income changes. Your bills don’t wait.
One client pays early. Another needs a reminder. Meanwhile, rent and subscriptions are due. Planning your money shouldn’t mean piecing together invoices, bank balances, and spreadsheets.
Some months are busy. Others are quiet. It’s hard to plan when your income keeps changing.
The work is done, but the money hasn’t arrived. Know which invoices need a follow-up.
Bills arrive on schedule, even when clients don’t pay on time.
A clear view of your money, from your next payment to next month’s plans.
See what you’ve earned and what’s still on its way.
Track paid, pending, and overdue client invoices.
Keep upcoming bills and everyday spending in view.
Plan what to set aside for taxes and quieter months.
See how expected payments could shape your balance.
From scattered payments to a clearer plan.
Add your income, invoices, and bills.
Built for the way independent work pays.
See what’s paid, what’s due, and who to follow up.
See your commitments before you spend.
